headline: Weathered Expanse Tilts Colonial as Nevish Line Deadlocks
war_summary: Three hours have recast the Weathered Expanse: where this desk last found five Warden stands against two Colonial, the ledger now reads five Colonial to one Warden, with three bases in ruin and sixty-three flag events in the past day — the busiest count on the map, Spirit Watch, Wightwalk, and Crow's Nest the busiest posts. The Nevish Line, lately four Warden to three Colonial with one base down, now stands at an even four-four with every base held, yet its dead still mount fastest of any front — Warden losses near seventeen hundred the hour, Colonial above eleven hundred, both climbing. Linn Mercy keeps its eight-two Colonial majority, Warden dead running well ahead about Lathair and Outwich Ranch. Mooring County's flare at The Wind Hills carries into the evening, Colonial losses there outpacing Warden. Callahans Passage, second-busiest at our last press, has cooled markedly, while Callums Cape and the Dead Lands quicken sharply in the latest hour. Marban Hollow and Stlican Shelf stay quiet on flags. It is day 745; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
